arrivals: Something has arrived and it has arrived by being still.
There's something here now. It came without approaching.
The stillness in the room acquires a shape.
departures: The stillness goes back to being ordinary stillness.
It has withdrawn, unhurried, and taken the quiet with it.
looks: Still. Extremely still. It's very good at this.
It isn't looking at you. It has no obvious front.
It's the size of a person and the shape of a decision.
It has been here longer than you have and didn't mind waiting.
name: something being still
